notes.note: Warner was great again with his 3 goals from 24 disposals and 5 clearances.
Warner is having a stellar back half of the season with his third over 100 in a row. 25 disposals and a couple of goals for him.
Warner was great for the Swans with his 32 disposals and goal. He is having a great season and is proving to be a great selection.
2 goals for Warner from his 21 disposals. He was busy around the midfield and was one of just 6 players in the game to go over 100.

Warner was very good in this game with his 23 disposals but it was a 47% efficiency and 7 clangers that stopped him reaching the 100 mark. He is playing good footy which will correlate to good scores.
Warner did get plenty of it but his efficiency was well down at 58% which did hold his score back to his lowest since round 11.
Warner was the shining light for the Swans booting 4 goals and having 8 clearances and 14 contested possessions. The return of Gulden didn't hurt him this week.
Warner provided some good midfield linkage play and slotted a goal from his 26 disposals with him now on a good run of 3 games.
Warner kicked 3 goals for his best score this season from his 32 disposals.
Just 11 disposals at 45% for Warner and this was his lowest for the season. Poor game for him this week and you could be excused for having him on your trade out list.
Warner went missing with just 19 points at the half but it was a big third term that got him to a respectable score.
18 touches and a goal for Warner with 11 contested possessions. His scores have been hovering around this area for the last 7 games.
Warner took a while to get going with just 9 points in the first quarter. He finished strong but his 21 disposals came at just 47% efficiency.
Warner was a very popular pick up this week with his price and bye coming into play. 20 disposals and 3 goals meant he made his BE and had his first ton of the season.
Chad has been good without being great. Not someone to bring in just yet.
Warner was seen in bursts during the game Another to watch but may not be in your starting squad.
